premises.text: Employers on traditional boards get flooded with mostly irrelevant applications and waste hours filtering
premises.evidence_span: I spend hours sifting through the noise to find those 10 best

premises.text: Job seekers cannot get noticed and lack view and feedback signals on applications
premises.evidence_span: I also want to know what my application's viewed. I also want to know what the employer thought of me

premises.text: Handpicked uniform full-time listings exclude scams and multi-level marketing
premises.evidence_span: we handpick every single job that's posted on our site. That means that they're all full-time opportunities. There's no multi-level marketing. There's no scams

premises.text: Job seekers paying to apply causes employers and recruiters to notice them
premises.evidence_span: employers and recruiters that we work with know that job seekers pay to apply on LocalBacon. And they notice that

premises.text: Employers agree to give feedback and notify seekers when applications are viewed
premises.evidence_span: employers and recruiters agree to give feedback and allow the job seeker to know when they view their application

premises.text: Job credits priced from $0.99 with volume discounts monetize paid applications and add-on services
premises.evidence_span: We're going to start at $0.99. And this is how our system works. When you go to apply to a job, as a job seeker, you can purchase job credits

premises.text: Familiar employer workflow with flag/shelve and ATS handoff preserves recruiter behavior while adding transparency
premises.evidence_span: we tried to make it as familiar for the employer and recruiter to use so they're not changing their behavior

value.text: Fix hiring for both job seekers and employers via quality matching with notice and transparency
value.evidence_span: created LocalBacon to fix the fundamental problems that exist for both job seekers and employers
